title: ui: Studio test `DataPillar.panelGate` "refuses a rule guard that does not parse" timed out in the merge queue with no `studio-save` button, on a PR that does not touch Studio
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmRY38EZf38Yy3zthbY

Filed by the seat from the #36364 card thread. PR #36606 was removed from the merge queue at 08:08Z. Its one red test is in a Studio file the PR does not touch. Not claimed: seat 2 is winding down and takes no new cards.

Suggested-grade: p2 (p1 if it repeats: it blocks the merge queue)
Suggested-domain: `domain:ui`

## Where

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/DataPillar.panelGate.test.tsx:156`, `it('refuses a rule guard that does not parse')`. After a 5027 ms timeout it cannot find `data-testid="studio-save"`.

## Reading

- Merge-queue run 45133910959, job 137556364792 (`Test UI` shard 7/16): 1 failed, 444 passed. The merge group is PR #36606, which changes nothing under `studio-design`.
- Same test family as the closed flake #36619 (`DataPillar.panelHold-27629`), but a different case.
- Recent `studio-design` changes on main: #36636 (06:15Z; Save now waits for a transition-priority render before reading the hold, which is the #36619 fix), #36641 (06:50Z), #36597 (03:09Z).

## Likely cause (not verified)

The Save button is drawn only while the page holds edits. #36636 changed when Save reads the CEL verdict. This case may now need longer than the 5 s wait under queue load, or the button may not appear at all on the parse-fault path. Read #36636's diff against this case before calling it load-only.

## Re-check

Run this file 20 times on a loaded box at main: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell vitest run src/views/studio-design/DataPillar.panelGate.test.tsx --repeat 20`, or the repo's equivalent.
